text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under the scorching sun, training 
continued heading toward the Sprinters 
Stakes.
choice_data_list: Pump your arms! Lengthen your stride!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What we are working on now is the 
acceleration burst right after the start. 
Specifically, trying to reinforce the 
initial acceleration.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... When I step down firmly, it seems I 
slip...
choice_data_list:
That's because you aren't stepping 
straight forward.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Which means that a portion of the force 
from your kick is being wasted."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I didn't even notice. This won't do! I 
must fix it completely!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Calstone-san's acceleration was in a 
league of its own, after all. Perhaps 
there was simply no need for 
counter-strategies until now?"
choice_data_list:
Yeah. I figured it could wait, so it 
wasn't a problem
Yeah. It was totally fine to put it off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If it weren't for the showdown with Sakura 
Bakushin O, I probably would have put off 
dealing with it until later.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Accelerative sprinting requires powerful 
foot strikes and a widened stride. It's 
the exact opposite of mid-race sprinting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had avoided training them simultaneously 
out of concern that it might disrupt her 
form during the middle phase of the run. 
However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you can't secure the position you 
planned beforehand, it becomes harder to 
run the race you envisioned. Improving 
acceleration is essential for positioning.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Kick off with all my might. Lengthen my 
stride... Focus on moving horizontally 
across the ground...
choice_data_list:
Let's try doing it together with Bakushin 
O next time.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It is my turn, then. Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I see, so as long as I can accelerate 
faster than Bakushin O, I'm good. Got it.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O, I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Light O-kun. That's quite a large meal 
for you, how rare.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you usually cut back on carbs, 
saying you couldn't run as fast if you 
gained weight?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
These are my Trainer's instructions. 
Training camp involves high-intensity 
workouts, so I was told to eat this much.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... 60% carbohydrates, 20% protein, 20% 
fat... Fat primarily from omega-3s via 
mackerel and perilla oil. Plus protein, I 
see.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I see, this menu has been designed with 
building both muscle and endurance in 
mind.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
By the way, what's the training menu for 
this afternoon?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I heard it would be light. You did say 
there wouldn't be any endurance running.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Is there something bothering you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, quite the opposite. Your Trainer's 
risk hedging seems to be impeccable!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Even if you increase the engine 
displacement, if the frame is fragile, it 
could tear apart from gravity and wind 
resistance. Strengthening both to the same 
level... That's the ideal.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"...Tachyon, you're beating around the 
bush. Just say what you want to say!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! My apologies. What I meant to say 
is... you should accurately assess your 
airframe's specs.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I don't get it at all!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what will you be doing this 
afternoon?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I did plenty of runs this morning to build 
acceleration, which put a heavy load on my 
legs. So this afternoon, I intend to do 
only light, playful exercise, but—
choice_data_list: Is there a game you'd like to play?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Slacking off is not allowed, Trainer. It 
is still time for training.
choice_data_list:
No, no, this play is actually part of your 
training.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Right O-senpai! Why not join in 
together? Playing all by yourself isn't 
really fun, right?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, you're right. Playing 
by yourself on a summer beach. It's way 
too loaded with meaning. Visually 
speaking, that is.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Training while playing is always more fun 
with more people, after all~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus, an Umamusume with a heart of 
justice, and Hishi Akebono, who excels at 
cooking, invited me to a joint training 
session.
choice_data_list: I'd love for you to join me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yay~! What sounds good, Biko-chan?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Smashing watermelons wrapped in 
straw or a free-diving contest! When it 
comes to games that are easy on the legs, 
these are it!
choice_data_list: Why something easy on the legs?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I was watching your morning training! 
Anyone's legs would turn to jelly after 
running that much with Bakushin O-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Sand is soft, but it takes power to run 
on. It really tires out your legs, ya 
know~?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"To think you saw right through me! 
Honestly, if I let my guard down, my legs 
would start shaking. Just like a newborn 
fawn."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's such a classic 
short-distance Umamusume thing~

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So, which one do you wanna do—the 
water-straw-melon split or a skin-diving 
contest?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Since it is considered a part of training, 
I will leave the decision to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Watermelon splitting plus roof tile 
breaking equals: Water-tile Splitting! You 
put a roof tile on a watermelon, and smash 
'em both in one punch!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
There's a watermelon under ten roof tiles, 
so it takes quite a lot of strength~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Also, if you don't hit it dead center, 
it'll wobble and collapse.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
A high-difficulty watermelon split, huh? 
Now that gets me fired up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I see. To cleanly break roof tiles and 
watermelons, how you apply force is key. 
It seems core strength will be tested as 
well.
choice_data_list: This looks like it'll be great training!
Looks like it'll be great training!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hup... whoa-whoa-whoa! Stacking roof tiles 
on top of a watermelon is seriously 
hard...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me. Lining things up straight 
is my specialty. Whether it's vertically 
or horizontally.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Alright, how about this?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, it's super stable! The roof tiles 
haven't shifted at all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Usually the roof tiles stick out a bit 
and end up all uneven. These look like 
they'll be easy to break~."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'll go first!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Pegasus Screw Attack!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, I only broke the tiles... And I 
put my whole body into that hit, too.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Is the trick to use your body?
choice_data_list:
I don't think you can crack it with arm 
strength alone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you strike with just your arms, the 
watermelon will probably just roll away. 
Because your balance will be off, it will 
be hard to split unless you channel your 
full body's strength all the way down in 
one go.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'll try next!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Here it comes~, Buono Megaton Puuunch!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Aw man, the watermelon split, but five 
roof tiles are still left standing.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The roof tiles collapsed midway. And she 
crushed the watermelon with pure brute 
force.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I see~, so as far as splitting a straw 
watermelon goes, it's a failure.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Then it's your turn, Right O-senpai. Why 
don't you shout out a special move name 
too? It really puts power into it!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I don't have a special move.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll come up with one! How about 
"Mach Straight Attack"?!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Too long. I prefer it shorter.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Then 'Mach Straight Line' it is!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I can't put strength into words that end 
with "n."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're being too picky... How about 
"Mach Straight Line Boss"?!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Let's go with that.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Mach-Speed Straightaway Master!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crack-crack-crack! SPLIIIIIIIT!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Wh... What was that sound just now? I've 
never heard a noise like that before...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Look, Biko-chan! Both the tiles and the 
watermelon were split clean in two! Such a 
straight, beautiful cross-section~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because force was applied literally 
straight on, the roof tile and watermelon 
split cleanly from the center. It was 
truly a textbook strike.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Whoa! That's practically master level!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Heh, a master of straw-watermelon 
splitting, eh...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
That's so uncool! If you're gonna call me 
anything, make it "Straightaway Master"!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Alright, first up is a long-distance swim 
to a deserted island~.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Why? If it's just skin diving, you could 
do that around here, couldn't you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"We're not competing over who stays under 
the longest, we're competing to see who 
gathers the most shells!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The lodge caretaker said it was fine to 
gather shellfish as long as it's near the 
deserted island. If we catch a lot, let's 
all eat 'em together~!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Two birds with one stone, huh? I'm all for 
it. It has excellent cost-performance.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right, gonna swim all the way to the 
deserted island!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I heard there are lots of seashells a bit 
further from the shore. You saw them when 
you swam over, right?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Yes. Trainer, I leave the signal to you.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'll gather the most clams at top speed! 
Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The three dove into the sea and swam off 
together. Reaching a deeper area, they 
plunged beneath the surface. However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Splash! Splas-splash-splash!)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*! *pant*, *pant*... I can't stay 
under!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Calstone Light O couldn't duck under...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Right O-senpai, you can't dive?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. For some reason, I've always 
floated. I thought I might be able to dive 
in the sea, but...
choice_data_list:
You float more easily in the ocean than in 
a pool, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seawater is heavier and more buoyant than 
fresh water. That's why it's easier to 
float in the ocean.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Kh, so you're saying I have no chance of 
winning? Frustrating! Losing by forfeit is 
far too frustrating!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about Right O-san 
gathers them where his feet can touch the 
ground?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's a free-diving showdown, so keep your 
faces in the water!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Right! Right O-senpai, think you can 
gather some shellfish with that?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Let's give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: *gasp*!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
(Alright, I can reach it at this depth. 
Though walking kicks up the sand and ruins 
visibility.)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
(Right, a handstand! If I do a handstand, 
I can grab the shells before kicking up 
sand!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Looks like Right O-senpai is picking them 
up while doing a handstand.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. All you can see are legs sticking 
out of the sea~.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...You know, for some reason, this whole 
scene feels super familiar...
choice_data_list:
Did you see that in a detective mystery 
drama or something?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ah! That's it!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: *gasp*! Alright, big haul! One more time!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oops, Biko-chan, let's get going too! Or 
Daitaku Helios will beat us~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the free-diving showdown, the three 
gathered a mountain of shellfish. There 
were far too many, so the match was 
declared void. They kept only an 
appropriate amount and returned the rest 
to the sea.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And the shellfish we gathered were 
deliciously cooked by Hishi Akebono, and 
we all savored the meal together."
